resetConfirmMsg:
All your data will be erased from our servers and this phone: pregnancy profile, appointments, tasks, measurements, symptoms, reminders and emergency contacts. You will then be signed out.

Your account is kept: you can sign in again with the same email address and start over. To delete the account as well, use “{{deleteLabel}}”.

To keep a copy, export your data first: {{settings}} → “{{exportLabel}}”.
resetConfirmMsgGuest:
All data on this phone and on our servers will be erased: pregnancy profile, appointments, tasks, measurements, symptoms, reminders and emergency contacts. Without an account there is no other copy, and this cannot be undone.

To keep a copy, export your data first: {{settings}} → “{{exportLabel}}”.
resetDoneMsg: Your data has been successfully deleted.

deleteAccountMsg:
Your account and email address will be deleted, together with all your data: pregnancy profile, appointments, tasks, weight, blood pressure, glucose, symptoms, reminders and emergency contacts, on our servers and on this phone (hospital bag, baby kicks, contractions, hydration, saved articles). This cannot be undone.

To keep a copy, export your data first: {{settings}} → “{{exportLabel}}”.
reauthMessage: To permanently delete your account, enter your password.
reauthFinishMessage: Your data has already been erased. Enter your password to finish deleting your account. If you cancel, you will be signed out and the deletion will finish the next time you sign in.
deleteDoneMsg: Your account and all your data have been permanently deleted.
deletePendingRetryMsg: Your data has been erased, but deleting the account itself did not go through (connection?). Retry now, or sign out: it will finish the next time you sign in.
deletePendingSignInMsg: Your data has already been erased, but deleting your account is not finished. Sign in with your password to finish it.
deleteIncompleteMsg: Some of your data could not be erased. Your account has been kept so you can try again. Check your internet connection, then retry.
resetIncompleteMsg: Some of your data could not be erased. Check your internet connection, then try again.
deleteBlockedMsg: Part of your data could not be erased because of a problem on our side, not on your phone, so trying again will not help. Please write to us at {{email}} and we will finish erasing it for you.
